description: Verbose phrase -> direct word dictionary for rewrite-clarity (theme 'Verbose phrases'). Shipped with a committed default set; grown when a run discovers a new verbose phrase and the user confirms it. Applied by scripts/replace_words.py with no LLM.

rules.verbose: The wordy phrase, lower-case. Matched case-insensitively on whole-word boundaries; the replacement keeps the match's capitalisation (Title-case first letter, or ALL CAPS).
rules.direct: The direct replacement. Must be semantically equivalent wherever 'verbose' appears in the 'replacements' tier.
rules.replacements: AUTO tier: always equivalent, applied by the script on --write without asking.
rules.suggestions: REVIEW tier: usually better, but the replacement breaks in some contexts (e.g. a following gerund or noun, a tense change). Never applied by the script; reported with line numbers for the agent or the user to decide.
rules.keep: Phrases confirmed acceptable as written, so the agent's sweep stops proposing them. The script ignores this key.
rules.note: Free text: why an entry sits in its tier, or the context where it breaks.
rules.skipped: Never matched inside fenced code blocks, inline code, [[wikilinks]], markdown link targets or bare URLs.

replacements.verbose: in spite of the fact that

suggestions.note: Breaks before a gerund or noun: 'for the purpose of testing' -> 'to test', not 'to testing'.
Breaks before a noun: 'in the process of elimination'. Fine before a gerund: 'in the process of migrating' -> 'currently migrating'.
